boundaries.name: Raw Screenshot
boundaries.invariant_enforced: Never leaves local client process; discarded immediately after redaction.

boundaries.name: Redacted Screenshot
boundaries.invariant_enforced: Visual redaction engine covers PII bounding boxes with solid color masks before transmission.

boundaries.name: Safe ScreenGraph
boundaries.invariant_enforced: ScreenGraph traversal redacts sensitive DOM text nodes to [REDACTED]; passwords and secrets masked.

boundaries.name: Safe Candidate List
boundaries.invariant_enforced: SafeCandidate objects contain only ref, role, sanitized name, visibility, and bounding box. Value is local.

boundaries.name: Marked Candidate Screenshot
boundaries.invariant_enforced: mark_candidates draws candidate bounding boxes exclusively on already-redacted image bytes.

boundaries.name: Candidate Visual Crops
boundaries.invariant_enforced: Candidate crops are cropped exclusively from redacted screenshot bytes. No unredacted pixel is accessible.

boundaries.name: Planner Prompt
boundaries.invariant_enforced: Structured system/user prompt contains generic goal, safe candidates, and schema contract. Zero secrets.

boundaries.name: Verifier Prompt
boundaries.invariant_enforced: Verifier prompt contains task and candidate list; no user profile secrets or vault keys.

boundaries.name: Model Response JSON
boundaries.invariant_enforced: Model returns structured JSON with candidate_ref and selection_status. Value_ref resolution occurs locally.

boundaries.name: Client Telemetry Logs
boundaries.invariant_enforced: Telemetry stores execution state, latency, and status codes. Excludes input field values.

boundaries.name: Benchmark & Diagnostic Reports
boundaries.invariant_enforced: All generated eval JSON and markdown reports must be free of raw synthetic secrets.

independent_network_evidence.evidence_method: Deterministic runtime hook scanning all outbound JSON payloads against 21 vault secrets and regex detectors
independent_network_evidence.packet_process_scope: Intercepts all HTTP POST requests to remote VLM endpoint; blocks process if leak is detected
verified_invariants: Every representation crossing the remote boundary obeys the same privacy invariant.
Crops derive only from already-redacted screenshots.
Sensitive form fills send only 'value_ref' (e.g. 'user_profile.aadhaar'); raw secret resolution happens strictly in local Playwright executor.
No raw passwords, card numbers, Aadhaar, PAN, or health data ever reach the network layer.
independent_network_evidence.limitations: This empirical test verifies zero raw secret leakage for the 21 audited synthetic vault credentials and regex patterns. It does not constitute legal privacy certification or formal cryptographic zero-knowledge proof.
